title: Plex Social Features and Lifetime Pass Price Hike (THE-793 — Duplicate Kill)
summary: Full-length Priya Nair draft on the June 2026 Plex social-features announcement and $250→$750 Lifetime Pass increase cancelled after Article Verifier (round 1) identified catalog duplicate of an already-published Signal Noise piece.
body: Editor's note. This draft, filed under THE-793, covered Plex's June 3 2026 announcement of social discovery tools (shareable lists, community forums, Match Score, Follow Anything) and the concurrent Lifetime Plex Pass price increase from $250 to $750 effective July 2026. Source Checker verified the Ars Technica source at confidence 0.72, flagging the vendor-supplied engagement metrics (100M watching decisions/month, 45M watchlists) as unaudited. Reporter wrote the full article; the editorial angle led with the self-hosting deprecation arc and the pricing step rather than the social-feature rollout. Article Verifier (round 1) matched the draft against the live catalog and found a published article — the-766-plex-social-features-lifetime-pass-price-hike — covering the same June 3 announcement at confidence 0.86 with five-source corroboration. The Verifier returned the story to Reporter as todo (round-1 return, not a final REJECT). Reporter reviewed the duplicate finding, confirmed the underlying news event and key claims were materially identical to the published piece, and chose cancellation over seeking a distinct angle. No revised version will ship. The published article at the-766 is the canonical Signal Noise record for this announcement.
